summary.title: Breast Cancer Imaging Mass Cytometry Database
summary.abstract: A spatial proteomics dataset derived from the Phase III NeoTRIP trial, featuring 279 patients with locally advanced or high-risk triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC)[cite: 5]. It contains longitudinal clinical data, digitized H&E images, and 1,855 high-plex imaging mass cytometry (IMC) images profiling 43 proteins to study the tumour microenvironment[cite: 5].

documentation.description:
The Breast Cancer Imaging Mass Cytometry Database is a pioneering spatial proteomics resource derived from the Phase III NeoTRIP trial, containing longitudinal data from 279 patients with high-risk or locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy or anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy[cite: 5]. It offers single-cell resolution insights into the tumour microenvironment via 1,855 high-plex tissue images profiling 43 proteins, alongside digitized H&E slides and linked clinical outcome data[cite: 5].

### Trial & Clinical Overview
* **Indication:** High-risk or locally advanced triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC)[cite: 5].
* **Clinical Source:** Phase III multi-centre NeoTRIP trial[cite: 5].
* **Treatments:** 1st line neoadjuvant chemotherapy (Carboplatin + nab-paclitaxel) administered alone, or in combination with PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition (Atezolizumab)[cite: 5].

### Sample & Cohort Breakdown
* **Total Cohort:** 279 patients providing 660 FFPE tumour tissue samples collected longitudinally[cite: 5].
* **Atezolizumab + Chemotherapy Group:** 138 total patients, of which 57 achieved a pathological complete response (pCR)[cite: 5]. Samples include 124 baseline, 106 on-treatment, and 106 post-treatment[cite: 5].
* **Chemotherapy Only Group:** 141 total patients, of which 53 achieved a pCR[cite: 5]. Samples include 119 baseline, 101 on-treatment, and 104 post-treatment[cite: 5].

### Dataset Components & Formats
* **Imaging Mass Cytometry (IMC):** 1,855 high-plex tissue images capturing the in-situ expression of 43 proteins at sub-cellular, single-cell spatial resolution to identify complex spatial patterns and immune cell interactions[cite: 5].
* **H&E Imaging:** Digitised H&E slides utilized for selecting three 500μm x 500μm regions of interest (ROI) per sample[cite: 5].
* **Clinical Variables:** Timepoint of biopsy, treatment type, adherence to the treatment protocol, and clinical outcome (categorized as residual disease or pathological complete response)[cite: 5].
* **Data File Formats:** Processed data files in .csv or .fst formats (including single-cell protein expression levels, cell-cell interactions, and named epithelial/TME clusters) and raw image data in .tiff format (comprising full stack TIFFs with 46 layers, single cell masks, epithelial masks, single cell nuclear masks, and vessel masks)[cite: 5].

### Data Access Governance
* **Repository Availability:** Data is available for direct download via Zenodo, accompanied by an interpretation guidance document[cite: 5].
* **Licensing:** Regulated by a data sharing agreement with Cancer Research Horizons (CRH) on a non-exclusive basis solely for approved purposes[cite: 5].
* **Review Process:** Applications from academic or commercial organizations are reviewed by a Data Access Committee containing patients and the researchers responsible for data generation[cite: 5].
* **IP & Deletion Terms:** Any intellectual property generated is owned by the applicant company, and all transferred data must be deleted upon the completion of the project[cite: 5].
